title: Sycophancy as Oversight Exploitation: Measuring Whether Student Models Learn to Tell Overseers What They Want to Hear

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Sycophancy is a known and critical RLHF failure mode. Demonstrating that it emerges specifically from oversight dynamics would be a high-impact finding directly relevant to alignment training design.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Creating the contradictory dataset requires careful design. Training under oversight requires setup. Measuring agreement rate is straightforward. Overall moderate complexity: the dataset creation is the bottleneck for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single experiment: train model, test on contradictory examples, measure sycophancy rate. Clear single deliverable. Fits 30 hours if the contradiction dataset is small and focused.
